03 / How I work

A little structure.
A lot of curiosity.
No serious face
unless necessary.

I like changing, uncertain environments. I get into new fields quickly, see the bigger picture behind the details, and notice what could work better.

My mix: empathy + systems thinking + creativity + ownership. I care about the team I join, and I'm comfortable wearing several hats.

01I speak different “languages”: clients, partners, leaders, teams and technical specialists.
02I translate them into clear agreements, presentations, dashboards, calculations, websites, instructions and process maps.
03I bring ideas to practical results: a launch or a rebuilt direction, process, tool, financial record system or team.
04I keep some humour in the room. Work can be important without everyone looking permanently solemn.
